sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B AEON Uncensored: How This Abliteration Actually Works
sources.snippet: A community abliteration of Qwen3.8-27B explains its KL-drift methodology, judge-based refusal testing, and how to run the model via vLLM.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-GGUF · Models
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-GGUF GGUF quantized versions of the abliterated (uncensored) Qwen3.8-27B for use with llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, and other GGUF-compatible engines. Available Quantizations ... What is Abliteration? This model has the "refusal direction" removed from its weights, allowing unrestricted conversations.

sources.title: qwen3.8-27b - Cloudflare AI docs
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 27B is a 27-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen family, designed for vision, efficient general-purpose text generation and agentic workloads.

sources.snippet: W4A16 AWQ quantization of an abliterated Qwen3.8-27B with the MTP speculative-decoding module preserved - method, benchmarks on 2x RTX 3090, and four reproduction traps.
